assets.logo_monochrome: n/a — no separate monochrome asset is currently shipped; docs/brand-guidelines.md owns the future variant requirement
assets.app_icon: n/a — the current product surface is browser-based and ships no native application icon

style.iconography: Monoline/geometric inline SVG with consistent stroke treatment; vendor-neutral for core task concepts
style.motion: Short functional transitions only; non-essential motion honors prefers-reduced-motion and must not compensate for unclear structure
style.imagery: Operational product UI first; screenshots must be real implemented surfaces and concept mockups are reference-only
style.voice_microcopy: Concise, technical, state-explicit and recovery-oriented; avoid anthropomorphic or unmeasured marketing claims

durations.instant: 0ms for immediate state changes and reduced-motion fallback
durations.standard: n/a — no separate canonical standard-duration token is currently shipped; use fast functional motion unless a semantic need justifies a new token
durations.large: n/a — no large decorative/navigation duration is currently canonical

easing.enter: ease via --ds-transition-fast for current functional transitions
easing.exit: ease via --ds-transition-fast for current functional transitions
easing.move: ease via --ds-transition-fast for current functional transitions

spring.default: n/a — spring motion is not part of the current browser product language
spring.bounce: n/a — bounce is intentionally avoided for frequent technical workflows

motion_tokens.reduced_motion_strategy: Global @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) disables transitions/animations and restores immediate scrolling behavior in design-system.css.
